description: Test suite for batch error utility functions `extractBatchErrorMessage` and `formatUnavailableBatchError` in the 'batch-error-utils.js' module. It verifies error message extraction from various response structures and error formatting.

methods.name: extractBatchErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts and returns the top-level error message from an array of response objects, with fallback to nested error messages.

methods.name: formatUnavailableBatchError
methods.description: Formats an error or string as an error message indicating a file is unavailable.
